newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle lower but still rangebound.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle lower but still rangebound.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures continued to trade within their recent range and settled lower Thursday.
Nearby support was pegged at 97.50 and resistance at an uptrend line at 102.50, basis the January contract.
Volume was estimated at 1,000 lots, compared with Wednesday's official volume of 562 lots.
The most-active January contract settled 0.75 cent a lb lower at 99.15, having ranged from 100.60 to 99.00. The back months finished 0.75 to 1.15 weaker.

Market sources said with ample supplies forecast, prices could remain under pressure until temperatures in Florida dip low enough to prompt fear of fruit damage. The frost season officially begins Dec. 15.
